94fsckbzfd-ux/quant-etf-strategy.body:
# 📈 V8.8 Cross-Asset ETF Momentum Rotation Strategy

> Rotates once every 18 days. Executed manually, no broker API required.

## System Overview

This system rotates across 10 global risk ETFs and 2 safe-haven ETFs, based on a composite score of the 18-day RSRS momentum indicator and the 3-month momentum factor. It automatically generates trading signals every Friday at 14:45.

### V8.8 Version Updates

| Update | Description |
|--------|------|
| RSRS formula fix | r³/std_x → rolling OLS slope z-score; the 0.0 threshold now has statistical meaning |
| Composite two-factor score | RSRS z-score × 0.5 + 3-month momentum z-score × 0.5 |
| Volatility parity weighting | Replaces equal weighting; positions allocated by inverse realized volatility |
| Push notification upgrade | Email notifications → WeChat PushPlus push |

## File Descriptions

| File | Description |
|------|------|
| `v8_live_signal.py` | Main strategy engine, responsible for data retrieval, signal calculation, and order generation |
| `v8_live_config.py` | Strategy configuration file, containing all adjustable parameters |
| `portfolio_state.json` | Account position state file, automatically updated after each run |
| `requirements.txt` | Python dependency list |
| `.github/workflows/weekly_signal.yml` | GitHub Actions automation workflow |

## Automated Runs (GitHub Actions)

This repository has GitHub Actions configured. It **automatically runs the strategy every Friday at 14:45 (Beijing time)** and sends notifications via WeChat PushPlus.

### Setup Steps

In the repository, go to **Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions** and add the following Secret:

| Secret Name | Description |
|-----------|------|
| `PUSHPLUS_TOKEN` | PushPlus user Token (obtained after logging in at [pushplus.plus](https://www.pushplus.plus)) |

### Getting a PushPlus Token

1. Visit [pushplus.plus](https://www.pushplus.plus) and log in by scanning the QR code with WeChat
2. After logging in, your **user Token** is shown on the homepage
3. Copy the Token and add it to the GitHub repository's Secrets (named `PUSHPLUS_TOKEN`)

### Manual Trigger

On the **Actions → 📈 V8.8 ETF Momentum Rotation** page, click **Run workflow** to trigger a run immediately.

# dsh-gitbash-shell

简体中文 | [English](https://github.com/KannaKuron/dsh-gitbash-shell/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md)

> **Unreleased / experimental implementation discussion**: The fail-closed behavior and the two explicit tools described below have not been formally released and are not a release candidate. Installing the public npm package does not guarantee these changes are included. See [design, interface and pending decisions](https://github.com/KannaKuron/dsh-gitbash-shell/blob/HEAD/<docs/experimental-native-execution.md>), [verification matrix and reproduction](https://github.com/KannaKuron/dsh-gitbash-shell/blob/HEAD/<docs/experimental-native-verification.md>), and the CHANGELOG.

> An official-style plugin that makes DeepSeek Harness (dsh) **run commands with Git Bash by default** on Windows.
> It does not replace the host executor (the official PowerShell executor is kept as is). It adds its own bash tool (a private Git Bash executor instance, not registered as a service) and registers a Git Bash version of the agent preset for every mode.

## What problem it solves

The official Windows combination defaults to `dsh-pwsh-sandbox` as `ctx.shell` (the PowerShell executor), and the `tool-bash` line in each preset is disabled on win32. The reason is that on Windows, a bare `bash` resolves to `C:\Windows\System32\bash.exe` (the WSL placeholder). This plugin **does not replace that executor**. It adds its own `bash` tool, which runs on a private Git Bash executor instance (inheriting the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox`, where `bashPath` only accepts Git for Windows). Sandbox semantics are fully preserved on POSIX hosts. On Windows hosts, restricted mode has one important exception. See ["Security semantics: restricted mode on Windows"](#安全语义windows-上的受限模式) below.

After installing this plugin (from v0.35.0, **by default**):

- **The four official modes get Git Bash directly.** The mode list stays as it is in the official version and no new variants are added. When each session is created, the plugin probes that mode's tool surface. ## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

# SniShaper

[中文](https://github.com/SnishaperTeam/SniShaper/blob/HEAD/README.md) | [English](https://github.com/SnishaperTeam/SniShaper/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md) | [Русский](https://github.com/SnishaperTeam/SniShaper/blob/HEAD/README_RU.md)

**SniShaper** is a local proxy application designed for complex network environments. It uses multiple approaches, including **ECH injection**, **TLS fragmentation**, **QUIC conversion**, and **session migration**, to provide stable and flexible network access in challenging conditions.

This project supports multiple platforms. See **[Platform.md](https://github.com/SnishaperTeam/SniShaper/blob/HEAD/docs/Platform.md)** for details.

---

## Sister Project: FlowWeaver

[**FlowWeaver**](https://github.com/SnishaperTeam/FlowWeaver) is the full-featured fork of this project, led by the original author. The two projects are **maintained in parallel**:

| | SniShaper (this repository) | [FlowWeaver](https://github.com/SnishaperTeam/FlowWeaver) |
|---|---|---|
| Positioning | Lightweight proxy server | Full-featured client / gateway |
| Core capabilities | ECH injection, TLS fragmentation, session migration | Clash subscription adaptation, all-protocol nodes, WireGuard, TUN gateway |

The two codebases are independent and can evolve separately, while subscription and rule file formats remain compatible. If you need **proxy provider subscription import, multi-protocol node selection, or WireGuard tunnels**, please use FlowWeaver.

The proxy engines of both projects come from the independent library **[snishaper-core](https://github.com/SnishaperTeam/snishaper-core)**. That library provides the proxy service, rule engine, DoH resolution, certificate management, and TUN data plane. This repository keeps only the application layer (GUI, CLI, system integration, and rule data).

---

## Community Groups

You are welcome to join the QQ group **[Snishaper and FlowWeaver building](https://qm.qq.com/q/GtBOkAOiME)** to discuss directly with users and developers of SniShaper and FlowWeaver, report issues, and submit suggestions.

**VersePC2** is the Tauri rewrite of VersePC, a Minecraft launcher built with a Rust backend and a web frontend. Compared with the Electron version, it is lighter, starts faster, and uses less memory, while retaining full functionality.

## Features

### Game Launching
- One-click installation and launch of Vanilla, Forge, Fabric, NeoForge, and OptiFine
- Automatic detection and installation of Java runtimes
- Smart memory allocation and JVM argument optimization (including CDS / JVM warm-up)
- Launch argument construction, per-version settings (isolation, memory, commands, etc.)
- Real-time game log monitoring and console output

### Account System
- Microsoft official account login (full OAuth flow: device code / interactive authorization)
- Offline accounts
- authlib-injector third-party authentication server login
- Avatar and skin management (multiple skin sources)

### Version Management
- Local / external version folder management
- Cross-disk "one-click version folder detection" with automatic scanning
- Per-version settings (icon / name / description / favorite / isolation)
- Version cleanup and disk usage management

### Mods and Modpacks
- CurseForge and Modrinth mod search, download, and installation (domestic mirror acceleration)
- Modpack import: CurseForge format + Modrinth `.mrpack` format (theseus ecosystem)
- Mod JAR parsing, dependency checking, batch downloading
- Datapack, resource pack, and shader pack management

### Multiplayer
- **Terracotta**: NAT traversal, allowing play with friends without a public IP; supports host / client modes
- **LAN Portmap (Lan Portmap)**: automatic UPnP port mapping
- **Private servers**: one-click server creation and management

jianzhuguo/ontodb.description: OntoDB — Ontology-Kernel Embedded Multi-Modal Semantic Database
jianzhuguo/ontodb.body:
# OntoDB — Multi-Modal Semantic Database with an Ontology Kernel Embedded

**[English](https://github.com/jianzhuguo/ontodb/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)** | Chinese

**The world's first multi-modal semantic database that embeds an OWL reasoning engine in the database kernel**

Supports unified storage of 12 data types. A single INSERT automatically completes a 7-step linked write pipeline. Embedded incremental reasoning delivers 100x the performance of external solutions.

---

## Why OntoDB

**The current state at most teams**: relational data in MySQL/PostgreSQL etc., graphs in Neo4j, vectors in Milvus, time series in InfluxDB, reasoning in Jena. Answering one question spans 5 systems, writes require ETL sync afterward, and classification knowledge is hard-coded in the application. **Lots of data, little knowledge.**

OntoDB solves this with one engine:

| Dimension | Traditional approach | OntoDB |
|------|----------|--------|
| **Architecture** | MySQL + Neo4j + Milvus + InfluxDB + PostGIS + Jena, 6 systems | **1 system**, 12 data types stored uniformly |
| **Semantics** | Semantics generated by an ETL process after writing, with latency from seconds to minutes | **Semantically ready at write time**, the 7-step linked pipeline completes atomically with microsecond-level latency |
| **Reasoning** | Reasoning engine is external, data is moved between systems | **OWL reasoning embedded in the storage engine**, shared memory space, zero data movement |
| **Query** | SQL + Cypher + SPARQL + dedicated APIs, 4 languages | **OntoQL**, a single syntax fusing relational, graph, vector, and reasoning |
| **Semantic metadata** | Metadata only describes table structure (`pg_catalog`), classification knowledge lives in application code | **Ontology is metadata**: class inheritance, equivalence, and disjointness are reasoned over, and `subClassOf` queries expand subclasses automatically |
| **Deployment** | 6 separate systems, complex operations | **Three-tier edge deployment**, one architecture from ESP32 to cloud servers |
| **Multi-tenancy** | tenant_id added at the application layer, easy to miss | **Namespace isolation in the kernel**, key-prefix routing with zero overhead |
| **Data lifecycle** | Fixed TTL expiry, unaware of data value | **Living-data decay**: data gets more alive the more it is used, with no automatic downgrading needed |
| **Reliability** | Depends on luck and restarts | **Block-level CRC + sentinel checks**, corrupted data is deterministically rejected, heap corruption root causes are closed |
| **Cost** | 6 systems × 6 sets of operations × 6 licenses | **1 system**, operations cost reduced by 80%+ |

# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My Devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA Lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network Status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

- **Multi-device monitoring**: add, name, and view devices by public Miner ID, filtering by contributing, waiting for tasks, needs checking, and pending confirmation.

- **Training history**: view training tokens, throughput, and cumulative tokens by day, week, or month; missing data is left as gaps.
- **Network visualization**: regional distribution donut chart, miner count rankings, slot occupancy, task progress, and tier overview.

nu1lkali/CineIsle.description: 影屿 (CineIsle) — a third-party Android client for Emby servers
nu1lkali/CineIsle.body:
🎬 Direct-link playback without transcoding · 📥 Offline downloads · 🖥️ mpv / GSY dual engine · ☁️ AList cloud storage ·
📀 Remote ISO disc images · 🧑 Merged cast & crew · 📺 DLNA casting · 🖼️ Photo albums & pictures

## Project background

We started out using a third-party Emby player. It worked fine, but it was missing some features we wanted, so we requested them. The author was not very willing to build them and didn't reply much.

So we had no choice but to build it ourselves.

Writing a player engine from scratch was not realistic, so we chose a solid player as the foundation: **[mpvEx](https://github.com/marlboro-advance/mpvEx)** (built on mpv-android / libmpv). mpvEx is a good **local** player in its own right, but it doesn't include an Emby client.

That led to **影屿 / CineIsle**: on top of mpvEx, we built a complete Emby client and then added, one by one, the features we needed for ourselves.

A player shouldn't only play titles from Emby, so network storage was filled in as well: SMB / FTP / WebDAV, plus a native API client written specifically for AList. The same AList server can also be connected via WebDAV, but the number of requests for listing directories, fetching covers, and playing media differs by an order of magnitude. See [Features](#功能) for details.

The name comes from "the island of movies": a place to gather the films you want to watch.

---

## Tech stack

| Area | Choice |
| :-- | :-- |
| **Language / UI** | Kotlin · Jetpack Compose (Material 3 Expressive) · single Activity + Navigation 3 |
| **Architecture** | Layered (`domain` / `ui` / `database` / `preferences`) · Koin dependency injection · Coroutines + Flow |
| **Persistence** | Room 2.8 (KSP-generated, schema export, migration tests) · `me.zhanghai.compose.preference` |
| **Network** | OkHttp 5 + kotlinx.serialization (hand-written Emby client, plus AList native API client) · SMBJ / Sardine / Commons Net (SMB / FTP / WebDAV) · NanoHTTPD (local Range proxy) |
| **Playback** | libmpv (`mpv-android`) as the primary engine · GSYVideoPlayer 13.2 (IJK / System / ExoPlayer) as the alternative · AndroidX Media3 ExoPlayer 1.10 handles multi-instance playback of 视界流 streams |

rumoii/streamfirefly.description: Web media detection and download tool with a browser extension and a Windows native helper.
rumoii/streamfirefly.body:
# 流萤 StreamFirefly

Local-first web media discovery and download tool

**[Download](https://github.com/rumoii/streamfirefly/releases/latest)** · [Installation Guide](https://github.com/rumoii/streamfirefly/blob/HEAD/INSTALL.md) · [Usage](#使用) · [Privacy Policy](https://github.com/rumoii/streamfirefly/blob/HEAD/PRIVACY.md) · [English](https://github.com/rumoii/streamfirefly/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

StreamFirefly consists of two parts: a browser extension and a Windows native helper. The extension detects videos, audio, images, and HLS/DASH manifests on web pages. The native helper, written in Rust, handles downloading, queuing, resumable downloads, and FFmpeg merging. Tasks and settings are stored only on the local machine.

The current version is 1.0.9. StreamFirefly does not bypass DRM. Please only download content that you own the copyright to or are authorized to download.

StreamFirefly ships in two distributions built from the same source code:

- **General edition**: No website restrictions. Distributed via GitHub Releases. Includes the Chrome/Edge extension, the signed Firefox extension, and the Windows native helper. Whether content can be detected and downloaded still depends on the website itself.
- **Chrome Web Store edition**: Per Chrome Web Store policy, does not detect or download YouTube content. (Still under review, so StreamFirefly may not appear in store search.)

## Highlights

## Features

- Identifies media URLs from network requests, response types, media elements, JSON/text, and inline scripts. Can also parse HLS manifests that pages generate in memory via POST, Blob, or scripts. Manifests loaded before StreamFirefly was opened are backfilled from page resource timing when it opens.
- Regular files support 1–16 concurrent Range-request connections. Paused downloads resume by segment. Falls back to a single connection if the server does not support segmented downloads.
- For HLS, you can choose quality, external audio tracks, multiple subtitles, and time or segment ranges, with standard AES-128 support. Merging does not transcode; audio-only output is M4A. The parse page lets you play the selected range to confirm the content before deciding whether to download.
- HLS live streams can be manually started, paused, and stopped for saving.
- DASH on-demand (experimental) lets you select one video track and one audio track, outputting MP4 or MKV.
- Tasks are queued in order, with up to 2 downloading at once. After the native helper restarts, resumable tasks continue automatically.
- Clicking the toolbar icon opens a draggable, resizable floating panel on the current page, which expands into a workspace when needed. The color scheme follows the system light/dark setting.
- Optional features: detection rules, URL extraction, output templates, sending to external tools (Aria2, HTTP service, local programs, custom protocols), deep search, and cache capture.

# bsl-ai-toolkit — AI agent writes 1C code from real code, not from memory

*AI agent toolkit for 1C:Enterprise 8.3 (BSL) development. MIT. Documentation is in Russian.*

A set of **rules, skills and MCP servers** for developing **1C:Enterprise 8.3 (BSL)** with an AI agent. The agent searches the code of your configuration and extensions, receives BSL Language Server diagnostics after every edit, and changes metadata (forms, DCS, attributes) with a deterministic engine verified in a test base. The reference implementation is Claude Code; Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cline, Windsurf and Aider connect via adapters built on the shared core. MIT license, no ties to any specific organization.

## Quick start
```bash
git clone https://github.com/vgtitov/bsl-ai-toolkit && cd bsl-ai-toolkit
bash onboard/onboard.sh          # macOS/Linux; 1C sources — from ONEC_SRC_DIR or --srcdir <path>
```
```powershell

```
